The '''Ithorian vacsuit''' was an [[Environment suit/Legends|environment suit]] used by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] [[Dawson (Tynnan)|Dawson]] used one such suit in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] during a [[Heist on the Song of the Clouds|heist]] on the [[Ithorian Herdship|Ithorian herdship]] ''[[Song of the Clouds]]''.
